reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles has 1 active non-test caller (index.ts:68 registers POST /api/roles/sync). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; bearer-token auth on entry point does not map to a trusted data source lookup. Gate 3: stem-bot-v2 not listed in out_of_scope. Spec deviation confirmed — discord_uid is used unsanitized in logger.info() (rolesSync.ts:206) enabling log injection, and passed raw to guild.members.fetch() enabling Discord API rate-limit abuse. An attacker can trigger this via POST /api/roles/sync with a valid API_AUTH_TOKEN by supplying a crafted discord_uid (e.g., containing newlines or tight-loop invalid IDs), causing structured log injection and Discord API quota exhaustion. Exploitability is conditioned on possessing the API_AUTH_TOKEN secret, limiting this to insider threat or credential-compromise scenarios; CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. MEDIUM severity is consistent with moderate bounded impact and required authentication.
